name: jt-glogarch
description: A complete log archiving and restoration solution designed for Graylog Open. -  為 Graylog Open 打造的完整 log 歸檔與還原方案。

paragraphs: Graylog Open Archive — Archive & restore logs for Graylog Open (6.x / 7.x)

Graylog Open does not include the Archive feature available in the Enterprise edition. jt-glogarch fills this gap by providing a complete log archival and restoration toolkit, supporting two export modes:
It exports logs to compressed archives (.json.gz) with SHA256 integrity verification, and can restore them back into any Graylog instance via GELF (UDP / TCP).
features: Graylog REST API — Standard, works with any Graylog Open install
OpenSearch Direct — Bypasses Graylog and queries OpenSearch directly (5× faster)

Graylog 7 Data Node users: Data Node environments use Graylog-managed TLS certificate authentication for OpenSearch. No credentials are exposed externally, so external tools cannot access OpenSearch directly. OpenSearch…

Graylog API mode & index.maxresultwindow: Graylog API export uses time-window offset pagination bounded by OpenSearch's index.maxresultwindow (default 10000). jt-glogarch keeps every request within this limit…
Same-mode exact match prevents re-exporting identical time ranges

requirements.text: Changes are made with the logged-in user's own Graylog account (its permissions apply); the password is exchanged for a Graylog session at login and never stored.
Emergency local login — when Graylog is offline, login with localadmin account (SHA256 hashed password, generate with glogarch hash-password)
